answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks with a bounded-degree vouch graph: each attested agent can certify only a few others, and a new agent needs several certifiers whose slots are scarce. An attacker cannot self-certify; every fake identity must consume a real peer's limited voucher, so the cost grows quadratically with the number of faces, and reused roots get slashed. A zephyr of disposable names cannot pass without shale-solid backing from unrelated accounts, and a comet swarm of clones collapses once its vouchers trace back to one operator.
